description: Source code for the Windows DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher in Chromium, handling DHCP queries to retrieve PAC URLs via Windows DHCP API and managing fetch operations.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Handles DHCP-based PAC URL fetching on Windows, managing DHCP queries and PAC script fetch operations.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Represents a DHCP query to retrieve PAC URL for a specific network adapter.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates DHCP query to fetch PAC URL for a network adapter.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing DHCP PAC URL fetch operation.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if the fetch operation has completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result code of the fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL obtained from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to retrieve PAC URL from DHCP server for a given network adapter.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes DHCP API string data to ASCII, trimming whitespace and nulls.
